citation.title: Chapter 8: Plasma operation and control
citation.authors: Gribov Y., Humphreys D., Kajiwara K., Lazarus E.A., Lister J.B., Ozeki T., Portone A., Shimada M., Sips A.C.C., Wesley J.C.

topic: Review of the ITER plasma control system, plasma initiation, magnetic control, and kinetic/performance control, with discussion of integrated simulators.
own_question: How do tokamak experiments since 1999 and ITER design studies bear on plasma initiation and basic magnetic and kinetic control for the 15 MA ITER?
actual_method_and_evidence: The chapter reviews experiments, including DIII-D and JT-60U initiation, real-time equilibrium reconstruction, AUG regime identification, and JET q/rho*Te profile control. It also reports ITER simulations made with TRANSMAK, PET, DINA and CREATE-L. The source does not address CES or impurity Ti nowcasting, BES/ECEI estimators, or validation designs. The review lists real-time diagnostic networks and profile feedback but gives no CES latency analysis.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reviews of tokamak control describe profile feedback that relies on real-time diagnostic networks and estimated profiles. This motivates timely profile estimates in general.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Sec. 4.2.1 'Control of profiles'; Sec. 4.2.3; pp. S397-S400
claim_checks.qualification: The cited examples are electron temperature, q profile and rho*Te control. None involves impurity CES Ti, and the review does not establish a need for CES nowcasting.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The source gives no CES report timing. The quoted cycle times concern equilibrium and q-profile reconstruction in other devices.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this source for CES or impurity Ti latency, for BES/ECEI usefulness, or for KSTAR.
Do not treat simulated ITER control performance as demonstrated performance.
Do not claim the review requires ion temperature nowcasting.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional, as a general background citation on the role of real-time profile control. It has no specific bearing on the CES nowcasting question, so a more targeted CES or real-time profile reference is preferable.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
